children.game_version: Sock hop freeze dance where partners perform two-step until music stops.

seniors.seated_version: Seated rhythm clapping and upper body lead-follow arm movements matching duple or triple music timing.
seniors.standing_version: Slow-tempo partner hold traveling with reduced stride length and supported turns.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo with small walking steps.

learning_units.description: Basic two-step traveling pattern in partner hold.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Standard social ballroom frame holding partner hands and shoulder/back.
movement_profile.footwork: Mix of loopdans, two-step, swing, boogie, social foxtrot, and quickstep steps; boerewals (Viennese waltz) steps used for waltz meters.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couples traveling counter-clockwise around a social dance floor.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Natural social ballroom rotation during turns and traveling patterns.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Grounded social footwork without elevated jumps.
movement_profile.posture: Upright ballroom posture modified for relaxed social lead and follow.

signature_moves.description: Viennese waltz style turning pattern executed within a sokkie framework.
signature_moves.name: Boerewals

signature_moves.description: A continuous walking/traveling step pattern shared with partner.
signature_moves.name: Loopdans

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Varies from energetic quickstep/swing pace to smooth waltz rotation.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid footwear that slips on slick floors if dancing in socks.

music_profile.sound_description: Commercial Afrikaans pop music characterized by electronic dance beats, popular pop melodies, and translated catchy hooks designed for partner dance halls.
music_profile.vocal_style: Afrikaans popular vocal music, often translating English hits into Afrikaans

basic_steps: Adopt a closed or open social ballroom frame with partner
